output.summary: Group ticket time rose about 4 minutes in all nine locations in October 2024, exactly as the board's study projected and accepted, with a 19-minute ceiling. Satisfaction and food quality rose, and speed scores were unchanged, so group-wide inefficiency and satisfaction erosion are not supported. Riverside's spike began after the saute/pasta cook left in August, with the KDS delay concentrated at that station, the vacancy unfilled and transfers deferred by group operations. Other locations show no staffing spread. Delgado's reason for leaving is unresolved, so GM replacement is unjustified. A 2023 audit showed ticket-time bonuses induce KDS gaming. Restore Riverside staffing and reset the benchmark. Do not freeze the menu or add the bonus.
